approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would take money from the Consolidated Revenue Fund to pay for the Parliamentary Departments in 2023-24.
It does this by setting out the specific appropriations in the bill's schedules, which are detailed in the Portfolio Budget Statements.
The bill is one of several Budget Bills that together fund new measures and ongoing government programs for the financial year.
Appropriates money for the Parliamentary Departments for 2023-24.
Provides the legal authority to spend from the Consolidated Revenue Fund.
Works with other Budget Bills to cover ordinary annual services and other appropriations.
The Parliamentary Departments and the government programs they administer.

The Appropriation (Parliamentary Departments) Bill (No. 1) 2023-2024 seeks over $314 million from the Consolidated Revenue Fund, including $250 million for the Department of Parliamentary Services to address accommodation pressures and ICT services, and a $1.9 million advance to the responsible Presiding Officer.
